summary: Important: firefox security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Mozilla Firefox is an open-source web browser, designed for standards compliance, performance, and portability.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * libexpat: denial of service via crafted XML input (CVE-2026-45186)
  * expat: expat: Information disclosure via heap buffer over-read in XML_ParseBuffer (CVE-2026-77214)
  * firefox: thunderbird: Privilege escalation in the Application Update component (CVE-2026-109704)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the XML component (CVE-2026-109718)
  * firefox: Incorrect boundary conditions in the JavaScript Engine component (CVE-2026-109715)
  * firefox: firefox: Sandbox escape via incorrect boundary conditions in Win32 widget (CVE-2026-109740)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the Storage: IndexedDB component (CVE-2026-109706)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the Crash Reporting component (CVE-2026-109713)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the DOM: Core & HTML component (CVE-2026-109724)
  * firefox: Information disclosure, privilege escalation in the Security: Process Sandboxing component (CVE-2026-109709)
  * firefox: Sandbox escape, site isolation issue due to incorrect boundary conditions, use-after-free in the Networking component (CVE-2026-109705)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component (CVE-2026-109729)
  * firefox: Incorrect boundary conditions in the JavaScript Engine component (CVE-2026-109716)
  * firefox: Race condition, use-after-free in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component (CVE-2026-109719)
  * firefox: Integer overflow in the Layout: Text and Fonts component (CVE-2026-109723)
  * firefox: Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Networking component (CVE-2026-109708)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the DOM: Bindings (WebIDL) component (CVE-2026-109717)
  * firefox: Sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the Networking component (CVE-2026-109707)
  * firefox: JIT miscompilation in the JavaScript: WebAssembly component (CVE-2026-109720)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the SVG component (CVE-2026-109726)
  * firefox: Integer overflow in the Graphics component (CVE-2026-109730)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the Audio/Video component (CVE-2026-109727)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the DOM: Streams component (CVE-2026-109732)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the DOM: Core & HTML component (CVE-2026-109725)
  * firefox: Sandbox escape due to uninitialized memory in the Graphics component (CVE-2026-109712)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the Graphics: Canvas2D component (CVE-2026-109711)
  * firefox: JIT miscompilation in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component (CVE-2026-109722)
  * firefox: Use-after-free in the DOM: Animation component (CVE-2026-109728)
  * firefox: Incorrect boundary conditions in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component (CVE-2026-109721)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Firefox ESR 153 rebase [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-175166)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
